scenarios.name: test_scenario_a_simultaneous_independent_missions
scenarios.description: Two simultaneous missions operate on isolated temporary workspaces without cross-talk.

scenarios.name: test_scenario_b_cancel_one_mission_while_other_continues
scenarios.description: Canceling Mission A leaves Mission B running to successful completion.

scenarios.name: test_scenario_c_one_mission_times_out_while_another_completes
scenarios.description: Mission A timeout/deadline expiration terminates only Mission A; Mission B finishes cleanly.

scenarios.name: test_scenario_d_process_tree_cleanup_and_isolation
scenarios.description: Terminating Mission A cleans up only its own child processes; Mission B processes remain untouched.

scenarios.name: test_scenario_e_approvals_and_event_isolation
scenarios.description: Pending approval in Mission A does not block or leak into Mission B events or state.

scenarios.name: test_scenario_f_concurrent_deadline_and_cancellation_races
scenarios.description: Race conditions between cancellation and timeout are resolved safely without crashes or deadlocks.
